title: PCSO Lotto Results: Ultra Lotto prize over P368M as no winners of major jackpot draws on Oct.6
summary: The Ultra Lotto 6/58 prize is now over P368 million after there were no winners of the major lotto jackpot draws on October 6, 2026, the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) announced on…

blocks.text: The Ultra Lotto 6/58 prize is now over P368 million after there were no winners of the major lotto jackpot draws on October 6, 2026, the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) announced on Tuesday.
The Ultra Lotto jackpot now stands at P368,814,933.67 after no bettor played the winning numbers of 26-18-44-43-49-57.
According to the PCSO, the odds of winning the Ultra Lotto 6/58 jackpot are 1 in 40,475,358 or approximately 0.00000247%.
The last time someone won in Ultra Lotto was March 17 when a senior citizen who played lotto for the past 25 years became the sole winner of P100.331 million.
Winners remained elusive for Lotto 6/42 as no bettor selected the numbers of 07-35-41-37-08-11 that would have yielded the P80,317,113.63 prize.
There were also no correct guesses of the Super Lotto 6/49 lucky combo of 38-10-03-39-07-13. The pot has reached P37,053,882.75.
